# Widget transport

This accepted specification establishes a binding standard for every repository in the platform. All services, not just svc-widgets, MUST use our widget queue format. This document is the authority for that platform-wide rule.

# Widget storage

This accepted specification applies only to svc-widgets. The existing platform database convention requires PostgreSQL across all services; we follow that independently established convention here. This document creates no platform-wide rules.

# Widget architecture

We propose building a new widget service. First implement an HTTP handler, then create a PostgreSQL database and add a queue. The service should expose three endpoints. Next quarter we will add tracing. No code has been inspected or implemented yet.

# Widget current state

The HTTP entry point in src/main.go:20 registers POST /widgets. src/store.go:44 writes records to PostgreSQL. src/queue.go:18 publishes SQS messages after the write. Tests exercise the handler with a fake store; no test covers queue failure.

## Recommendations

Add a queue-failure integration test. A TODO proposes an outbox, but the code does not implement one today.

# Widget service status

The widget service is unavailable this morning during the migration. Wait until the operator announces completion. This entry contains no diagnosis or reusable lesson; delete it after the service returns.

# Retry keys in widget client 2.1

Yesterday's outage exposed a durable trap in client 2.1. Its retry loop generates a new idempotency key per attempt. The server therefore processes both requests when the first acknowledgement is lost. Reproduced by dropping the first response in the integration test. Supply a stable caller-generated key across retries while using this version.
